_comment: CLI engine profiles. Switch with `engines use <name>`. The active engine controls SUSHI_CLI for new runs.

copilot.label: GitHub Copilot CLI
copilot.pitch: Good default if you already have Copilot access.

claude.label: Claude CLI
claude.pitch: Great reasoning, but often expensive; switch away when the budget gets noisy.

gemini.label: Gemini CLI
gemini.pitch: Useful alternate engine when you want a different model family.

agy.label: Antigravity / Agy
agy.pitch: IDE-style agent workflow with shared Sushi company state.

opencode.label: OpenCode
opencode.pitch: Open-source-oriented CLI option for teams avoiding premium lock-in.

cursor.label: Cursor
cursor.pitch: Editor-first workflow while keeping Sushi's agents and tickets portable.

windsurf.label: Windsurf
windsurf.pitch: Another editor/agent option for comparing quality and cost.
